text_prompt.label: Text prompt
text_prompt.def: Free text, e.g. “calm synth-pop with female vocals”.

tags_features.label: Tags/features
tags_features.def: Preset parameters such as genre, tempo, key or mood.

score.label: Score/composition
score.def: Notes, chords or quantized MIDI without performance nuance.

performance_midi.label: Performance MIDI
performance_midi.def: MIDI with expressive timing and dynamics.

accompanies.label: Accompanies
accompanies.def: Output plays along with the input.

precedes.label: Precedes / Continuation
precedes.def: Output continues where the input ends, e.g. extends a melody or a track.

no_direct_connection.label: No direct connection
no_direct_connection.def: Input only guides content or style.

unlimited.label: Unlimited
unlimited.def: Runs on without a fixed end.

dimensions.label: Chronological along output?
dimensions.def: Yes if the input runs along the output's timeline, e.g. a recording or MIDI track the output follows.

dimensions.label: Real-time capable?
dimensions.def: Yes if it responds fast enough to play live.
